## Description
Describe your changes in detail. Why is this change required? What problem does it solve?

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] MLA 9 compliance rule improvement / fix
- [ ] Performance optimization or UI enhancement
- [ ] Documentation update

## Checklist:
- [ ] My code follows the code style of this project (`cargo fmt --all -- --check`).
- [ ] I have verified that `cargo clippy --all-targets` produces zero warnings.
- [ ] I have run `cargo test` and all unit and integration tests pass.
- [ ] This change preserves strict MLA 9 formatting constraints (no arbitrary fonts, unconstrained sizes, or invalid margins).
- [ ] I have updated the documentation accordingly if applicable.
